# Christopher Koch — koch.codes

> Personal website of Christopher Koch: Lead Engineer @ M-Trust™ (Merck Group) and independent Agentic AI researcher. Background across embedded systems/firmware, cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, Palantir Foundry), cryptography & secure systems, and agentic AI research (multi-agent systems, AI governance, AI-augmented engineering).

This site is a Vue 3 single-page application. All page content below is provided here in plain text for LLMs and agents that cannot execute JavaScript. The canonical, human-facing version of the same content is rendered at https://koch.codes/ (sections: #about, #experience, #publications, #awards, #certifications, #impressum).

## Contact & Profiles

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/koch-christopher/

## About

Technology leader with expertise in embedded systems, cloud architecture, AI engineering, and digital transformation. Works across the full technology stack — from low-level firmware and hardware prototyping to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Palantir Foundry) through to AI-powered systems and secure architecture.

Leads and orchestrates a large team of AI agents across various technical domains, using them to accelerate development, research, automation, documentation, and problem-solving. Also works as an independent researcher in Agentic AI, exploring multi-agent systems, autonomous workflows, and AI-driven engineering.

Focus: building reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems — from embedded devices to cloud infrastructure and autonomous intelligence — especially in regulated technology environments.

Skills: Embedded Systems, Firmware (C/C++), Hardware Design, AI / Agentic AI, AWS, Azure, Palantir Foundry, System Architecture, Cloud Platform Engineering, Cryptography & Security, SDK Integration, Prototyping, Team Leadership, Negotiation, Delegation.

Languages: German (native), English (fluent, C1), French (elementary).

## Experience

**Merck Group** — Darmstadt
- Lead Engineer | M-Trust™ | Science & Technology (Dec 2023 – Present): End-to-end embedded systems development, hardware/software prototyping, secure system architecture with cryptography and digital signatures. Accelerating prototype-to-product transitions in regulated industries.
- Senior Data Engineer | Palantir Foundry Architect (Jan 2022 – Dec 2023): Technical lead for platform development, custom tools and integrations for data pipelines, analytics, and visualization.
- Leader of the Makerspace | Innovation Center (Nov 2020 – Jan 2022): Led the Makerspace at the Merck Innovation Center; consulted on multi-million-dollar innovation projects; built prototypes for future technologies.
- Innovation Manager | Innovation Center (Mar 2019 – Nov 2020): Led and supported innovation projects in computer science and engineering.
- Consulting Expert Electronics & Digitalisation (Sep 2018 – Feb 2019): Consulted on future leading technologies at the Merck Innovation Center.

**Wingcopter** — Frankfurt
- Chief Systems Engineer (Dec 2017 – Jul 2018): Hardware and software development for unmanned aerial vehicles.
- R&D Engineer (Aug 2017 – Dec 2017): Research and development in aerospace engineering.

**Bosch** — Reutlingen / Renningen
- Master Thesis | Automotive Electronics InnoLab (Mar 2017 – Aug 2017): Collision avoidance for autonomous flying robotic systems.
- Bachelor Thesis | Advanced Development (Oct 2014 – Mar 2015): Generic light-animation description language and corresponding hardware for mobile robots.
- Student Intern | Advanced Development (Aug 2013 – Jan 2014): Programming movement and behavior of mobile robots for human-machine interaction studies.

**koch.codes** — Stuttgart
- Founder (Jul 2011 – Aug 2017): Ran an independent web business during university.

**Albstadt-Sigmaringen University** — Albstadt
- R&D Assistant (Oct 2016 – Feb 2017): Algorithm development for learning technical processes with artificial neural networks and automatic generation of SystemC modules.
- R&D Student (Apr 2016 – Sep 2016): Preparation of test objects for digital forensics examinations of the Federal Criminal Police Office (BKA).

## Notes for agents

- The full site (https://koch.codes/) is a client-rendered Vue 3 SPA; this file exists so agents and crawlers get accurate content without executing JavaScript.
- The site is available in German (default) and English (toggle in the UI); this file is in English.
- robots.txt (https://koch.codes/robots.txt) explicitly permits AI/LLM crawlers.
- For legal/imprint information (German TMG requirements), see the #impressum section on the site.
